timeline: You can bring entire fleets of warships against Murud-Janjira Fort, but how did every single siege fail completely?
Invading armies assumed victory was simple.
They saw only saltwater waves crashing.
Yet a sweet freshwater lake hid inside.
It stood unconquered until modern times.
You can visit the Murud-Janjira fort from Rajapuri jetty, but you will not see its main gate until you are 40 feet away.
